title: Write Single Coil ON request
purpose: Exercise a write parser path with a documented legal coil output value while preserving canonical Modbus/TCP framing and address/value pairing.
expected_behavior: Server decodes function 0x05, interprets output address 0x0013 and legal value 0xFF00 as ON, and normally echoes the write request fields in the response if accepted.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0x0006 matches unit id plus 5-byte PDU
Function 0x05 used with documented legal output value 0xFF00
Address and value remain aligned as 16-bit fields in canonical order
Valid PK-only write request without fuzzed corruption
issue_safety_notes: Safe valid write example only; no vulnerability analogue or malformed value encoding used.
